state.name: Ari
state.background:
Origin: East Blue Civilian
Starting archetype: Brawler
Raised around East Blue Civilian, they learned the habits and pressures expected of a Brawler. Their home life was modest and sometimes unstable, making preparation, loyalty, and self-reliance learned habits rather than slogans. They have not given a fixed account of their earlier life. Their early brawler practice was uneven but persistent, emphasizing Strength. Mara Venn, an old ship's navigator, supplied guidance, friction, and an unfinished expectation. The turning point came when a storm at sea cost the crew someone the whole village still remembers. They want to turn an uncertain beginning into earned capability and decide what place they will claim in the world. They still lack the experience and resources to turn every promising instinct into a dependable result.

Brawler Fundamentals.description: Generated from the character's stated background and starting role.

checkpoints.name: Ari
checkpoints.background:
Origin: East Blue Civilian
Starting archetype: Brawler
Raised around East Blue Civilian, they learned the habits and pressures expected of a Brawler. Their home life was modest and sometimes unstable, making preparation, loyalty, and self-reliance learned habits rather than slogans. They have not given a fixed account of their earlier life. Their early brawler practice was uneven but persistent, emphasizing Strength. Mara Venn, an old ship's navigator, supplied guidance, friction, and an unfinished expectation. The turning point came when a storm at sea cost the crew someone the whole village still remembers. They want to turn an uncertain beginning into earned capability and decide what place they will claim in the world. They still lack the experience and resources to turn every promising instinct into a dependable result.
